## Singularity.purchaseCyberdeck() method

Purchases a Cyberdeck.

**Signature:**

```typescript
purchaseCyberdeck(): boolean;
```
**Returns:**

boolean

True if purchase is successful or if you already have a cyberdeck, false otherwise.

## Remarks

RAM cost: 2 GB \* 16/4/1

This function allows you to purchase a cyberdeck. The cost is the same as manually buying one from New Tokyo.
